items.heading: Many Beginners Say They Want
items.text: Many beginners say they want to get into data science when what they actually mean is data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or problem solving with data. That confusion creates bad course choices and unrealistic expectations.

items.heading: Cleaning Data, Answering Business Questions,
items.text: Cleaning data, answering business questions, building dashboards, finding patterns, and sharing recommendations.

items.heading: Sql and Query Thinking
items.text: SQL and query thinking. SQL is one of the clearest foundations because it forces you to work with real structured data.

items.heading: Visualization and Dashboards
items.text: Visualization and dashboards. Learn how to make decisions easier through Power BI, Tableau, or a similar reporting layer.

items.heading: Statistics and Business Interpretation
items.text: Statistics and business interpretation. Means, distributions, correlation, significance, and experiment logic matter because analysis is not only chart production.
